description: This file defines a mock class dsFPDMock for unit testing, which inherits from dsFPDImpl and uses Google Mock's MOCK_METHOD to mock various methods related to FPD (possibly Front Panel Display) functionalities.

classes.name: dsFPDMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of dsFPDImpl for unit testing, mocking methods related to FPD control.

methods.name: dsSetFPBlink
methods.description: Mocks setting the blinking parameters of FPD indicators.

methods.name: dsSetFPBrightness
methods.description: Mocks setting the brightness of FPD indicators.

methods.name: dsGetFPBrightness
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the brightness of FPD indicators.

methods.name: dsSetFPState
methods.description: Mocks setting the state of FPD indicators.

methods.name: dsGetFPState
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the state of FPD indicators.

methods.name: dsSetFPColor
methods.description: Mocks setting the color of FPD indicators.

methods.name: dsGetFPColor
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the color of FPD indicators.

methods.name: dsFPTerm
methods.description: Mocks termination or cleanup of FPD related resources.

methods.name: dsFPGetSupportedLEDStates
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the supported LED states.
